news.raw_snippet:
The fundraising comes as investors reassess valuations across the artificial intelligence industry. Concerns about infrastructure spending, data center construction, and the long-term economics of AI development have shifted market expectations.

For OpenAI, the latest capital infusion provides additional resources as it continues to compete in the rapidly expanding market for generative AI technologies, enterprise AI services, and advanced computing systems. [...] OpenAI has completed an initial $11 billion funding close at a $1.25 trillion valuation, according to Bloomberg, marking another major financing milestone for the artificial intelligence company behind ChatGPT. The investment represents the first portion of a larger fundraising round that could reach $20 billion in the coming weeks. The financing was transferred to OpenAI as of November 6, 2026, according to people familiar with the transaction. [...] The company has been pursuing additional capital to support its expanding artificial intelligence operations, including the substantial computing infrastructure required to develop and deploy advanced AI models.

news.title: AI助推个人创业者崛起，初创公司减少招聘
news.snippet: [AI工具显著降低创业门槛，美国涌现个人创业热潮，越来越多初创企业选择精简团队、减少雇佣规模。]
news.raw_snippet: America's entrepreneurial landscape is undergoing a quiet revolution. A new generation of small business owners is launching ventures without hiring a single employee, relying instead on AI tools to handle everything from bookkeeping to brand design. Fresh data shows this trend is accelerating fast, as artificial intelligence eliminates the traditional need to build teams before scaling revenue. For solo founders, the message is clear: you don't need a co-founder anymore when AI can be your [...] The rise of AI-powered solo entrepreneurship marks more than just a trend in business formation - it signals a fundamental restructuring of how companies can operate in their earliest stages. As AI tools continue to improve and founders grow more sophisticated in deploying them, the traditional playbook of "raise money, hire team, build product" is giving way to "build with AI, validate revenue, then decide if you need humans." Whether this proves sustainable at scale remains to be seen, but [...] The economics are compelling. Traditional startup wisdom said you needed to hire a bookkeeper, bring on a marketing specialist, maybe contract a designer. Each role meant salary, benefits, management overhead. AI tools have collapsed those costs to subscription fees that rarely top a few hundred dollars monthly. # Who Is Brian Chesky? Airbnb CEO and His New AI Lab

Updated November 7, 2026 (ET).

Photo: LeWEB12 (OFFICIAL LeWEB PHOTOS) via Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0
